content: Kadaudok en Nein Noha Pwutak kan
Iet kadaudok en nein Noha pwutak kan, Sehm, Ahm, oh Saped. Me silimenet naineki pwutak kei me ipwidi mwurin nohlik lapalapo.
Nein Saped pwutak kan iei—Komer, Makok, Madai, Sapan, Tupal, Mesek, oh Tiras—iei irail pwukat me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Komer iei irail mehn Askenas, Ripahd, oh Tokarma.
Kadaudok en Sapan iei irail mehn Elisa, mehn Spein, Saiprus, oh Rodes.

Iei irail me wia pahpa en aramas ako me kin koukousoan limwahn oaroahr oh nin deke kan. Ih met kan kadaudok en Saped, me kin koukousoan wasa kan rehn kadaudokarail tohrohr kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Nein Ahm kan iei—Kus, Isip, Lipia, oh Kenan—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en Kus iei irail mehn Sepa, Apila, Sapta, Raama, oh Sapteka. Kadaudok en Raama iei mehn Sipa oh Dedan.
Kus naineki pwutak emen ede Nimrod, me wiahla sounpei keieu lapalap emen nan sampah.
Sang ni kupwur kalahngan en KAUN-O e wiahla sounkesik koahiek men, iei kahrepen aramas akan ar kin nda, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwurei komwi pwe komwi en wiahla sounkesik koahiek men duwehte Nimrod!”
Nin tapio eh wehi iangahki Papilon, Erek, oh Akad, wasa siluh pwukat koaros mi nan Papilonia.
Sang nan wehio e ketila Asiria oh kauwada kahnimw kan en Ninipe, Rehopod Ir, Kala,
oh Resen, me mihte nanpwungen Ninipe oh kahnimw laud en Kala.
Kadaudok en Isip kan iei mehn Lidia, Anam, Lehap, Napdu,
Padrus, Kaslu, oh Krihd, me mehn Pilisdia kan pwilisang ie.
Nein Kenan pwutak—Saidon, me keieu laud, oh Hed—irail me pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kenan pil wia pahpa kahlap en mehn Sepus, mehn Amor, mehn Kirkas,
mehn Ip, mehn Ark, mehn Sin,
mehn Arpad, mehn Semar oh mehn Amad. Kadaudok en mehn Kenan ikiparpeseng,
lao irepen Kenan lellahng palieir en Saidon lel Kerar limwahn Kasa oh kolahng palimese lel Sodom, Komora, Adma, oh Sepoim limwahn Lasa.
Ih met kan kadaudok en Ahm, me kin koukousoan rehn kadaudokarail kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Sehm, rien Saped me laud, ih me wia pahpa kahlap en mehn Ipru koaros.
Nein Sehm pwutak—Elam, Ahsur, Arpaksad, Lud, oh Aram— irail me wia pahpa kahlap en aramas ako me weuwa adarail kan.
Kadaudok en mehn Aram ko iei mehn Us, Hul, Keder, oh Mesek.
Arpaksad me naineki Sela, Sela me naineki Eper.
Eper naineki pwutak riemen: emen adaneki Pelek,
pwehki nindokon eh mwehi aramas en sampah pwalpeseng wiahda pali kei; oh meteio adaneki Sokdan.
Kadaudok en Sokdan kan iei mehn Almodad, Selep, Asarmaped, Sera,
Adoram, Usal, Dikla,
Opal, Apimael, Sipa,
Opir, Apila, oh Sopap. Irail koaros pwildohsang Sokdan.
Sahpw me re kin kousoan ie tepisang Mesa kolahng Separ ni palimesehn sahpwo.
Ih met kan kadaudok en Sehm, me kin koukousoan rehn kadaudokarail kan oh wasa kan, ehuehu pwihn kin lokaiahki pein ar lokaia.
Aramas pwukat koaros wia kisehn kadaudok en Noha, ehuehu wehi nin duwen wekpeseng en ar kadaudok. Mwurin nohlik lapalapo, wehin sampah kan koaros pwildohsang rehn nein Noha pwutak ko.

footnotes.text: PELEK: Sisen lepin mahsen wet ni mahsen en Ipru kereniong duwehte lepin mahsen me wehwehki “pwalpeseng.
